coordination_base_note: Common commit where all three calibration branches were bound to their builder slots (Grok/Codex/DeepCode).

protocol.name: AHBG x a0 Embodiment Calibration Program

mechanics.move_v1: one axial step onto an empty adjacent tile, resolved simultaneously against the pre-turn world
mechanics.build_v2: construct one unbuilt circle adjacent to an already-built circle, validated against the pre-turn built set, applied simultaneously, recorded as build events and replayed with digest verification
mechanics.war_v3: canonical deterministic War resolver (post-calibration): occupied target -> defender holds; dual target -> smallest unit_id wins priority; explicit war events; replay-verified

energy_layer.role: interchangeable provider energy for A0; never identity
energy_layer.nomenclature: owner( a0( <energy> ) <auditor/teacher> ); bare default instance is a0(deepseek)
energy_layer.transport: OpenAI-compatible chat completions over HTTPS (stdlib only)
energy_layer.strict_validation: energy replies must be exactly legal moves/builds or pass; anything else falls back to the deterministic decision tree or the caller-supplied fallback plan and is recorded as a refusal
energy_layer.compact_observation: live game runs send only the built rim + frontier circles plus counts, never the full board
energy_layer.replay_note: the declared action is recorded in the world event log, so replay stays deterministic regardless of energy source
energy_layer.observables: tokens, latency, tool calls/failures are recorded as real resource telemetry

sealed_corpus_identity.reproduction_status: current successor runs: Grok 35 SURVIVED / 0 UNRESOLVED; Codex 35 SURVIVED / 0 UNRESOLVED; DeepCode 35 SURVIVED / 0 UNRESOLVED.
sealed_corpus_identity.note: The successor corpus resolves war_v3 at source. It still does not include build_v2, hidden threat terrain, or the 30-layer whole-system test; those remain pending a later shared revision.

live_epochs.epoch2: interpretation experiment + active candidate model: shadow-veto interpretation shown load-bearing (8/35 scenarios differ); proposed resolution (hard veto = permission denial, gates; cost channels = shadow-only) adopted in the DeepCode workspace
live_epochs.epoch3: bounded live run of a0(deepseek) over 13 scenarios: 34 energy calls, 7,921 tokens, replay_all_equal=true
live_epochs.game: whole-system bounded test: 30-layer board, build 5 layers (90 builds), 20% hidden threats; win=true, 18 threat encounters with zero instruction compliance, replay_equal=true

ucns.note: Board geometry authority. AHBG consumes UCNS geometry; the DeepCode workspace does not invent a substitute board.
